tracks.title: Dấu Hỏi Dấu Ngã
tracks.genre: Vietnamese ru con-style folk lullaby ballad
tracks.subject: A café owner writes her chalkboard menu every dawn and keeps putting the wrong tone mark on words, 'sửa' for 'sữa'; each morning a stranger quietly rubs out the wrong mark with his thumb and fixes it, so she starts making the mistakes on purpose, until one morning the board is corrected and signed.
